entities.name: Beyeen
entities.description: Volcanic island off the coast of Ondu on Zendikar.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: Coastal settlement of Beyeen whose economy Indorel controlled.

entities.name: Indorel
entities.description: Vampire who dominated Zulaport's economy through enforcers; killed.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who passed through Beyeen in 4557 AR and summoned a giant beast to pull a ship.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker who killed and fed on Indorel's men.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Vampire who killed and fed on Indorel's men.

entities.name: Valakut
entities.description: Largest and most active volcano of the Crown of Talib.

entities.name: Talib
entities.description: God of the earth of the kor.

entities.name: Beyeen goblins
entities.description: Goblin bands in the Crown of Talib with a deep dynastic history.

events.summary: Nissa, Sorin and Anowon arrive in Zulaport on their way to Akoum and are given lodgings.
events.quote: they traveled into Zulaport, where they were given lodgings

events.summary: Sorin and Anowon kill and feed on two of Indorel's men, leading to a fight in which Indorel dies.
events.quote: Sorin and Anowon killed and fed on a pair of Indorel 's men

events.summary: The trio takes a ship, with Nissa summoning a giant beast to pull it across the Silundi Sea to Akoum.
events.quote: Nissa summoning a giant beast to pull them across the Silundi Sea to Akoum

relations.quote: Beyeen is an island off the coast of Ondu , on the plane of Zendikar .
Nissa Revane , Sorin Markov , and Anowon passed through Beyeen
leading to a violent confrontation where several of the Zulaport enforcers and Indorel himself were killed
